I think it's like, we're so used to having equal rights now that we don't even think about it. We just assume it's always been this way. But it's not like that. There were people who fought for this, who risked their lives for it. And it's not just about the Civil Rights Act, it's about all the little things too, like being able to sit at the front of the bus or being able to drink from the same water fountain as white people.
